subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text.
stimulus: Himi said to Rimi, "Why don't you get up early from sleep?" Rimi said, "It is tough to me to leave bed early." "Alas! It's a bad habit," said Himi. "If you leave bed early, you can enjoy sound health. Follow my advice," "I will try my best to do this," said Rimi.
guide_solution: Himi asked Rimi why she (R) didn't get up early from sleep. Rimi replied that it was tough to her to leave bed early. Himi exclaimed with sorrow that it was a bad habit and said that if she (R) left bed early she could enjoy sound health. And at last she (H) told her (R) to follow her advice. Rimi said that she would try her best to do that.
